name: wordpress_jobs-deals-mcp
description: WordPress Jobs (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (WordPress RSS 2.0, the latest 10 job posts); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). id is the job's permalink; description is the full post (content:encoded, HTML); the short excerpt is raw.description and the WordPress post id raw['post-id'].
